scoreboard_note: G7 blocked permanently (no official price). Reward pool rolls over unpaid.

gates.name: Minimum out-of-sample sample
gates.rule: At least 300 graded out-of-sample bets before a strategy can qualify.

gates.name: Probabilistic calibration
gates.rule: Model Brier score must beat the 0.2500 baseline with a paired-bootstrap 95% CI above zero.
gates.evidence: Not computable: no executable price exists to grade probability forecasts against (G7 blocked).

gates.name: Discrimination vs home baseline
gates.rule: Winner accuracy must exceed the home-team baseline with one-sided p < 0.05.
gates.evidence: No usable model edge measured; the rating model loses to the closing line (margin MAE higher than market proxy).

gates.name: Totals skill
gates.rule: Total MAE must beat the naive mean with permutation p < 0.05.
gates.evidence: Not measured this snapshot (only one completed game; no usable totals signal).

gates.name: Temporal stability
gates.rule: Performance must hold across consecutive time blocks (no single-week fluke).
gates.evidence: Insufficient sample: one completed game cannot form stable blocks.

gates.name: Dependence control for combinations
gates.rule: Parlay / prop-combo legs priced with measured dependence, not independence; n published with each correlation.
gates.evidence: Computed correlations use official standings only; player-prop correlations blank (no official per-game logs).

gates.name: Executable price
gates.rule: A strategy must be gradeable at an executed (archived) price.
gates.evidence: BLOCKED: the NFL publishes no betting odds, so no opening or closing price exists for any market. Gate can never pass until a licensed price archive is bought (suggestion S01).

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.rule: Every strategy test (including placebos) controlled at FDR q = 0.05 (Benjamini-Hochberg).
gates.evidence: No strategy survives; both pre-registered placebos fail as required.

gates.name: Source and usage compliance
gates.rule: Every published row links to its official source; unverifiable values are blank and flagged.
gates.evidence: Enforced by verify.py: 0 broken local links, every table row source-linked.

gates.name: Deterministic reproduction
gates.rule: Rebuild reproduces all numbers byte-identically from frozen knobs.
gates.evidence: Model knobs frozen in data/derived/model_ratings.json (frozen_utc stamped before holdout scoring).

gates.name: Demotion gate (live -> paper)
gates.rule: A LIVE strategy is demoted back to PAPER when (a) its week-clustered 95% CI on ROI includes zero for N=2 consecutive grading weeks, or (b) it fails FDR at q=0.05 on re-grade. A demoted strategy may not be staked live until it re-qualifies on a fresh holdout. One bad week does NOT demote; two consecutive CI-including-zero weeks do.
gates.evidence: No strategy is live (none qualified), so no demotion is triggered this snapshot. The gate rule is pre-registered and published.

note: Demotion gate G11 is pre-registered. No strategy is live this snapshot, so G11 is not triggered; it is published so the rule exists before any strategy goes live.
